verses.greek: Τὸν δὲ ἀσθενοῦντα τῇ πίστει προσλαμβάνεσθε, μὴ εἰς διακρίσεις διαλογισμῶν.
verses.literal: The one now being weak in the faith do receive not for passing judgment on reasonings.
verses.dgt: Now receive the one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

verses.greek: ὃς μὲν πιστεύει φαγεῖν πάντα, ὁ δὲ ἀσθενῶν λάχανα ἐσθίει.
verses.literal: One indeed believes to eat all things the one however being weak vegetables eats.
verses.dgt: One person believes they may eat all things, but the one who is weak eats vegetables.

verses.greek: ὁ ἐσθίων τὸν μὴ ἐσθίοντα μὴ ἐξουθενείτω, ὁ δὲ μὴ ἐσθίων τὸν ἐσθίοντα μὴ κρινέτω, ὁ θεὸς γὰρ αὐτὸν προσελάβετο.
verses.literal: The one eating the one not eating not he should despise the one now not eating him eating not he should judge the God for him has received.
verses.dgt: Let the one who eats not despise the one who does not eat, and let the one who does not eat not judge the one who eats, for God received that person.

verses.greek: σὺ τίς εἶ ὁ κρίνων ἀλλότριον οἰκέτην; τῷ ἰδίῳ κυρίῳ στήκει ἢ πίπτει· σταθήσεται δέ, δυνατεῖ γὰρ ὁ κύριος στῆσαι αὐτόν.
verses.literal: You yourself who are who is judging another’s servant? To the own master he stands or falls. He will be upheld however able is for the Lord to uphold him.
verses.dgt: Who are you who judges another’s household servant? To that servant’s own master they stand or fall. And they will stand, for the Lord is able to make them stand.

verses.greek: Ὃς μὲν κρίνει ἡμέραν παρʼ ἡμέραν, ὃς δὲ κρίνει πᾶσαν ἡμέραν· ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ νοῒ πληροφορείσθω·
verses.literal: One indeed judges a day to be above another day one other however judges every day alike Each in the own mind should be fully assured.
verses.dgt: One person judges one day above another, while another judges every day alike. Let each be fully convinced in their own mind.

verses.greek: ὁ φρονῶν τὴν ἡμέραν κυρίῳ φρονεῖ. καὶ ὁ ἐσθίων κυρίῳ ἐσθίει, εὐχαριστεῖ γὰρ τῷ θεῷ· καὶ ὁ μὴ ἐσθίων κυρίῳ οὐκ ἐσθίει, καὶ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: The one regarding the day to the Lord regards it and the one eating to the Lord eats he gives thanks for the to God and the one not eating to the Lord not he eats and he gives thanks the to God.
verses.dgt: The one who regards the day regards it for the Lord. And the one who eats eats for the Lord, for that person gives thanks to God; and the one who does not eat does not eat for the Lord and gives thanks to God.

verses.greek: Οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἑαυτῷ ζῇ, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἑαυτῷ ἀποθνῄσκει·
verses.literal: No one for of us to himself lives and no one to himself dies.
verses.dgt: For none of us lives to oneself, and none dies to oneself.

verses.greek: ἐάν τε γὰρ ζῶμεν, τῷ κυρίῳ ζῶμεν, ἐάν τε ἀποθνῄσκωμεν, τῷ κυρίῳ ἀποθνῄσκομεν. ἐάν τε οὖν ζῶμεν ἐάν τε ἀποθνῄσκωμεν, τοῦ κυρίου ἐσμέν.
verses.literal: If both for we shall live to the Lord we live if also we shall die to the Lord we die. If both therefore we shall live if also we shall die the Lord’s we are.
verses.dgt: For if we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. Therefore whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

verses.greek: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἔζησεν ἵνα καὶ νεκρῶν καὶ ζώντων κυριεύσῃ.
verses.literal: Unto this for Christ died and lived again that both over the dead and living He may rule.
verses.dgt: For to this end Christ died and lived, so that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

verses.greek: Σὺ δὲ τί κρίνεις τὸν ἀδελφόν σου; ἢ καὶ σὺ τί ἐξουθενεῖς τὸν ἀδελφόν σου; πάντες γὰρ παραστησόμεθα τῷ βήματι τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.literal: You yourself however why judge you the brother or you? or also you yourself why do despise the brother of you? All for we will stand before the judgment seat the of God.
verses.dgt: But you, why do you judge your brother or sister? Or you also, why do you despise your brother or sister? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God.

verses.greek: γέγραπται γάρ· Ζῶ ἐγώ, λέγει κύριος, ὅτι ἐμοὶ κάμψει πᾶν γόνυ, καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσεται τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: It has been written for: Live I myself says the Lord that to Me myself will bow every knee and every tongue will confess the to God.
verses.dgt: For it is written, “As I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow to me, and every tongue will confess to God.”

verses.greek: ἄρα ἕκαστος ἡμῶν περὶ ἑαυτοῦ λόγον δώσει.
verses.literal: So each of us concerning his own account will give
verses.dgt: So then each of us will give an account concerning oneself.

verses.greek: Μηκέτι οὖν ἀλλήλους κρίνωμεν· ἀλλὰ τοῦτο κρίνατε μᾶλλον, τὸ μὴ τιθέναι πρόσκομμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ ἢ σκάνδαλον.
verses.literal: No longer therefore one another shall we judge but this do determine rather the not to put any stumbling block the before your brother or snare.
verses.dgt: Therefore let us no longer judge one another, but judge this instead: not to place a stumbling block or trap before a brother or sister.

verses.greek: οἶδα καὶ πέπεισμαι ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ ὅτι οὐδὲν κοινὸν διʼ ἑαυτοῦ· εἰ μὴ τῷ λογιζομένῳ τι κοινὸν εἶναι, ἐκείνῳ κοινόν.
verses.literal: I know and I have been persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean through itself only except by the one reckoning anything unclean to be to that one unclean it is
verses.dgt: I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself; but to the one who considers something unclean, to that person it is unclean.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ διὰ βρῶμα ὁ ἀδελφός σου λυπεῖται, οὐκέτι κατὰ ἀγάπην περιπατεῖς. μὴ τῷ βρώματί σου ἐκεῖνον ἀπόλλυε ὑπὲρ οὗ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν.
verses.literal: If for on account of food the brother of you is grieved no longer according to love are you walking. Not with the food of you that one do destroy for whom Christ died.
verses.dgt: For if your brother or sister is grieved because of food, you are no longer walking according to love. Do not destroy by your food the one for whom Christ died.

verses.greek: μὴ βλασφημείσθω οὖν ὑμῶν τὸ ἀγαθόν.
verses.literal: Not should be denigrated therefore your the good.
verses.dgt: Therefore do not let your good be spoken of as evil.

verses.greek: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ βρῶσις καὶ πόσις, ἀλλὰ δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ χαρὰ ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ·
verses.literal: Not for is the kingdom the of God eating and drinking but righteousness and peace and joy in the Spirit Holy
verses.dgt: For the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

verses.greek: ὁ γὰρ ἐν τούτῳ δουλεύων τῷ Χριστῷ εὐάρεστος τῷ θεῷ καὶ δόκιμος τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.
verses.literal: The one for in this thing serving the Christ is well-pleasing the to God and approved the by men.
verses.dgt: For the one serving Christ in this is pleasing to God and approved by people.

verses.greek: ἄρα οὖν τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης διώκωμεν καὶ τὰ τῆς οἰκοδομῆς τῆς εἰς ἀλλήλους.
verses.literal: So then the things the of peace we may pursue and the things the for edification the among each other.
verses.dgt: So then let us pursue the things of peace and the things for building up one another.

verses.greek: μὴ ἕνεκεν βρώματος κατάλυε τὸ ἔργον τοῦ θεοῦ. πάντα μὲν καθαρά, ἀλλὰ κακὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ διὰ προσκόμματος ἐσθίοντι.
verses.literal: Not for the sake of food do destroy the work the of God. All things indeed are clean but it is evil to the man the through a stumbling block eating
verses.dgt: Do not tear down the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but it is evil for the person who eats through a stumbling block.

verses.greek: καλὸν τὸ μὴ φαγεῖν κρέα μηδὲ πιεῖν οἶνον μηδὲ ἐν ᾧ ὁ ἀδελφός σου προσκόπτει ἢ σκανδαλίζεται ἢ ἀσθενεῖ·
verses.literal: It is good the neither to eat meat nor to drink wine nor anything in which the brother of you stumbles or is led into sin or is weak
verses.dgt: It is good not to eat meat nor drink wine nor do anything by which your brother or sister stumbles.

verses.greek: σὺ πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις κατὰ σεαυτὸν ἔχε ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ. μακάριος ὁ μὴ κρίνων ἑαυτὸν ἐν ᾧ δοκιμάζει·
verses.literal: You yourself the faith that you have to yourself do keep before the God Blessed is the one not judging himself in what he approves.
verses.dgt: The faith that you have, keep to yourself before God. Blessed is the one who does not judge oneself in what one approves.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ διακρινόμενος ἐὰν φάγῃ κατακέκριται, ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως· πᾶν δὲ ὃ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἁμαρτία ἐστίν.
verses.literal: The one however doubting if he shall eat has been condemned because it is not of faith everything now that is not of faith sin is.
verses.dgt: But the one who doubts is condemned if they eat, because it is not from faith; and everything not from faith is sin.
